summary: Test-writing phase only (TDD red phase). Added two currently-failing XCTest cases pinning the manifest decode/encode behavior the generated OpenAPI client must have, plus a delta doc comparing docs/color-matching-api-contract.md against the real published spec (viamin/color_matching#113, closing #110). No implementation files were touched, per the test-writing run's TDD boundary. No Swift toolchain is available in this container, so the tests could not be compiled or executed here; they are expected to fail (red) until the manifest model is updated or replaced by the generated client in the implementation run.

acceptance_criteria.note: testManifestDecodingPreservesServerDeclaredCaptureProfile pins that capture_profile.scoring_algorithm_version must survive decode/encode. Currently fails (field is silently dropped by SheetManifest) because no Swift toolchain exists in this environment to execute `swift test`; expected red-phase result per source inspection of iOS/Sources/MeasurementCore/Models.swift (SheetManifest has no capture_profile property).
testManifestDecodingPreservesServerDeclaredPrinterProfile pins that printer_profile must survive decode/encode. Same no-toolchain caveat as AC-1.

Deltas were derived by reading the actual merged source of viamin/color_matching#113 (api_spec.ex, api_schemas.ex, test_sheet_json.ex, capture_controller.ex, router.ex, plugs/api_auth.ex) via public GitHub raw/API access and diffing against docs/color-matching-api-contract.md. This is a documentation deliverable, not an automated test; evidence is the doc content itself plus the cited upstream commit 094bd6d3443ddacbda7e63354299867eb5bdfa9f.

Adding swift-openapi-generator/swift-openapi-runtime to Package.swift, vendoring the live openapi.json, generating the client, and replacing hand-written models are implementation-file changes explicitly out of scope for this test-writing run (TDD boundary restricts this run to test paths and docs/). Deferred to the implementation run gated on paid-tests-approved.
